description: Each placement is in the fitted tank frame. Offset, floor, J1 and yaw errors in individual runs are signed. Wall error over reach is the maximum absolute base-y difference at x from -600 to 0 mm. First contact uses the CAD tip site speed at the first contact of each probe. Every later reacquisition is included by max_first_contact_speed_mm_s. Force is the sum of absolute normal reactions at all arm/environment contacts, averaged over a trailing 20 ms or instantaneous.
